name: merc engineer bomb ring
comment: The Space Merc Engineer's bomb ring, as players remember it: four bombs circling the spot he cast it on (they stay there when he moves) that blow up on a player. Spell 374158 is the engineer's (next to his shot's 374159-374161) but has no client definition, so its stats and actions are made up: an invisible anchor at his feet (npc/merc-engineer-bomb-anchor) that the bombs (skill/merc-engineer-bombs) circle.
